passage:
A school installed solar panels on its roof. Students could see a screen near the office showing how much electricity the panels produced each day.
On sunny days, the number was high. On cloudy days, it dropped. Students began checking the screen like a game.
The science teacher used the data to explain energy, weather, and storage. She also explained that solar power helps, but schools still need to save electricity.
The panels changed the roof from an empty surface into a lesson.
Clean energy became less abstract when students could watch it being made above their own classrooms.
